sentences.en: Last time we built first-order methods: a gradient, a retraction, and a step size.
sentences.zh: 上一集我们搭好了一阶方法：梯度、retraction 和步长。

sentences.en: Newton's method goes further. It solves Hess f of x, applied to s, equals minus grad f of x.
sentences.zh: Newton 方法更进一步：它要解 Hess f(x)[s] = −grad f(x)。

sentences.en: The Hessian is the derivative of the gradient. The gradient is a vector field.
sentences.zh: Hessian 是梯度的导数，而梯度是一个向量场。

sentences.en: So before anything else, we must learn to differentiate a vector field on a manifold.
sentences.zh: 所以首先要学会：怎样在流形上对向量场求导。

sentences.en: Start with the simplest manifold that is not flat: the unit circle in the plane.
sentences.zh: 从最简单的不平坦的流形开始：平面上的单位圆。

sentences.en: Walk around it at unit speed: gamma of t equals cosine t, sine t.
sentences.zh: 以单位速率绕圆走：γ(t) = (cos t, sin t)。

sentences.en: Its velocity, gamma dot of t, is minus sine t, cosine t.
sentences.zh: 它的速度 γ̇(t) = (−sin t, cos t)。

sentences.en: The velocity is orthogonal to gamma of t, so it lies in the tangent line at gamma of t.
sentences.zh: 速度与 γ(t) 正交，所以落在 γ(t) 处的切线上。

sentences.en: Here it is at every point: the velocity field of the curve.
sentences.zh: 把它画在每一点：这就是曲线的速度场。

sentences.en: The lecture asked: what is the derivative of this velocity field?
sentences.zh: 课上问的是：这个速度场的导数是什么？

sentences.en: Let us try the obvious thing: the difference quotient of gamma dot.
sentences.zh: 先试最显然的做法：对 γ̇ 求差商。

sentences.en: Gamma dot at t plus h, minus gamma dot at t, divided by h.
sentences.zh: γ̇(t+h) 减去 γ̇(t)，再除以 h。

sentences.en: To subtract, slide both arrows to a common base point. Their difference points toward the center.
sentences.zh: 要相减，先把两个箭头平移到同一起点；差向量指向圆心。

sentences.en: As h shrinks, the quotient tends to minus cosine t, minus sine t, which is minus gamma of t.
sentences.zh: h 趋于 0 时，差商趋于 (−cos t, −sin t) = −γ(t)。

sentences.en: That vector points straight at the center. It is perpendicular to the tangent line.
sentences.zh: 这个向量直指圆心，与切线垂直。

sentences.en: So the obvious derivative of a tangent field is not tangent.
sentences.zh: 所以，切向量场的显然导数并不是切向量。

sentences.en: Yet the walker moves at constant speed and never turns within the circle. Its acceleration should be zero.
sentences.zh: 可是行者匀速前进，在圆内也没有转弯，加速度本应为零。

sentences.en: What went wrong is the subtraction itself.
sentences.zh: 问题出在减法本身。

sentences.en: Gamma dot at t plus h lives in the tangent space at gamma of t plus h.
sentences.zh: γ̇(t+h) 属于 γ(t+h) 处的切空间。

sentences.en: Gamma dot at t lives in the tangent space at gamma of t.
sentences.zh: γ̇(t) 属于 γ(t) 处的切空间。

sentences.en: These are two different vector spaces. The plane lets us subtract, but the result has no reason to be tangent.
sentences.zh: 这是两个不同的向量空间；平面允许相减，但结果没有理由是切向量。

sentences.en: On a manifold without an ambient space, there is not even a plane to subtract in.
sentences.zh: 如果流形没有外围空间，连做减法的平面都没有。

sentences.en: The same failure hits the Hessian. Take the Rayleigh quotient on the sphere from last time.
sentences.zh: 同样的问题也落在 Hessian 上。取上一集球面上的瑞利商。

sentences.en: Its gradient field is V of x equals A x minus x transpose A x, times x.
sentences.zh: 它的梯度场是 V(x) = Ax − (xᵀAx)x。

sentences.en: Differentiate this formula in the ambient space, along a tangent vector u.
sentences.zh: 在外围空间里沿切向量 u 对这个公式求导。

sentences.en: We get Proj x of A u, minus x transpose A x times u, minus u transpose A x, times x.
sentences.zh: 得到 Proj_x(Au) − (xᵀAx)u − (uᵀAx)x。

sentences.en: The first two terms are tangent. The last one points along x, normal to the sphere.
sentences.zh: 前两项是切向的，最后一项沿 x 方向，垂直于球面。

sentences.en: Whenever u transpose A x is not zero, this derivative is not a tangent vector.
sentences.zh: 只要 uᵀAx ≠ 0，这个导数就不是切向量。

sentences.en: Then inner products like the one of Hess f of x u with u would make no sense.
sentences.zh: 那样一来，⟨Hess f(x)[u], u⟩ 这样的量就没有意义。

sentences.en: We need a new derivative for vector fields.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一种新的向量场导数。

sentences.en: The plan: list the properties of the ordinary derivative, keep them as axioms, and add what the metric demands.
sentences.zh: 路线：列出普通导数的性质，把它们当作公理，再加上度量要求的条件。

sentences.en: First, a closer look at how vector fields act on functions.
sentences.zh: 第一步，先仔细看看向量场怎样作用在函数上。

sentences.en: A vector field X assigns a tangent vector X of p to every point p.
sentences.zh: 向量场 X 给每一点 p 指定一个切向量 X(p)。

sentences.en: It acts on a smooth function f by differentiation: X f at p is D f of p, applied to X of p.
sentences.zh: 它通过求导作用在光滑函数 f 上：(X f)(p) = Df(p)[X(p)]。

sentences.en: The result is again a smooth function. So a vector field turns functions into functions.
sentences.zh: 结果仍是光滑函数。所以向量场把函数变成函数。

sentences.en: Here, f is drawn by its level curves, and the moving point reads off X f: large where X climbs f steeply.
sentences.zh: 这里用等值线表示 f，移动的点读出 X f：X 沿 f 爬得陡的地方值大。

sentences.en: We will also write the inner product of X and Y for the function p maps to the inner product of X of p and Y of p.
sentences.zh: ⟨X, Y⟩ 也记作一个函数：p ↦ ⟨X(p), Y(p)⟩。

sentences.en: Two fields can act one after the other: X of Y f.
sentences.zh: 两个场可以先后作用：X(Y f)。

sentences.en: Their commutator is called the Lie bracket: X Y bracket f equals X of Y f, minus Y of X f.
sentences.zh: 它们的交换子叫李括号：[X,Y] f = X(Y f) − Y(X f)。

sentences.en: In R n, write X equals X i times partial i, and Y equals Y j times partial j.
sentences.zh: 在 ℝⁿ 中，写 X = Xⁱ∂_i，Y = Y^j∂_j。

sentences.en: By the product rule, X of Y f is X i times partial i of Y j, times partial j f, plus X i Y j times the second derivative.
sentences.zh: 由乘积法则，X(Y f) = Xⁱ(∂_iY^j)∂_j f + XⁱY^j∂_i∂_j f。

sentences.en: Y of X f has the same form with X and Y exchanged.
sentences.zh: Y(X f) 的形式相同，只是 X 与 Y 对调。

sentences.en: Subtract. The second-derivative terms cancel, because mixed partial derivatives are symmetric.
sentences.zh: 相减。二阶导数项抵消，因为混合偏导数是对称的。

sentences.en: What remains uses only first derivatives of f: X of Y j minus Y of X j, times partial j f.
sentences.zh: 剩下的只含 f 的一阶导数：(X(Y^j) − Y(X^j))∂_j f。

sentences.en: So the Lie bracket is again a vector field. In R n, X Y bracket equals D Y of X minus D X of Y.
sentences.zh: 所以李括号仍是向量场；在 ℝⁿ 中，[X,Y] = DY[X] − DX[Y]。

sentences.en: Neither half is a vector field on its own. X of X f, for X equal to partial x, is the second derivative f x x.
sentences.zh: 单独一半不是向量场：取 X = ∂_x，X(X f) 是二阶导数 f_xx。

sentences.en: An example from the book. U is the constant field one, zero. V is zero, x one times x two.
sentences.zh: 书中的例子：U 是常向量场 (1, 0)，V = (0, x₁x₂)。

sentences.en: Take f of x equal to x two. Then V f is x one x two, and U of V f is x two.
sentences.zh: 取 f(x) = x₂。则 V f = x₁x₂，U(V f) = x₂。

sentences.en: U f is zero, so V of U f is zero. The bracket applied to f gives x two.
sentences.zh: U f = 0，所以 V(U f) = 0；括号作用在 f 上得 x₂。

sentences.en: As a field, U V bracket equals zero, x two. It points up, and grows with height.
sentences.zh: 作为向量场，[U,V] = (0, x₂)：指向上方，随高度增大。

sentences.en: What does the bracket measure? Start at the point one, one.
sentences.zh: 李括号度量的是什么？从点 (1, 1) 出发。

sentences.en: Flow along U for time epsilon, then along V for time epsilon. That is the orange path.
sentences.zh: 沿 U 的流走 ε 时间，再沿 V 的流走 ε 时间：这是橙色路径。

sentences.en: Now do it in the other order: V first, then U. That is the purple path.
sentences.zh: 再换个顺序：先 V 后 U，这是紫色路径。

sentences.en: The two endpoints do not meet. The gap, in red, is about epsilon squared times the bracket at the start.
sentences.zh: 两个终点不重合；红色缺口约等于 ε² 乘以起点处的李括号。

sentences.en: Here are the numbers: the gap divided by epsilon squared is 1.25, 1.11, 1.05 and 1.03, approaching one.
The bracket at the start is zero, one, so the limit is exactly right.
sentences.zh: 起点处的括号是 (0, 1)，极限正好吻合。

sentences.en: Coordinate vector fields always commute: partial i, partial j bracket is zero.
sentences.zh: 坐标向量场总是对易的：[∂_i, ∂_j] = 0。

sentences.en: The reason is the same symmetry of mixed partials. The grid squares close up.
sentences.zh: 原因同样是混合偏导的对称；网格的小方块是闭合的。

sentences.en: As the lecture put it, the bracket measures the non-commutativity of differentiation along fields.
sentences.zh: 按课上的说法：李括号度量的是沿向量场求导的不可交换性。

sentences.en: These are the tools the axioms will use: X f, the inner product of fields, and the bracket.
sentences.zh: 公理要用的工具就是这些：X f、场的内积和李括号。

sentences.en: In a linear space, a vector field V has an ordinary derivative: D V of x, applied to u.
sentences.zh: 线性空间中，向量场 V 有普通导数 DV(x)[u]。

sentences.en: It has three basic properties. First, it is linear in the direction u.
sentences.zh: 它有三条基本性质。第一，对方向 u 线性。

sentences.en: Second, it is linear in the field: the derivative of a V plus b W is a D V plus b D W.
sentences.zh: 第二，对场线性：aV + bW 的导数是 a DV + b DW。

sentences.en: Third, the product rule: D of f V along u equals D f of u times V, plus f times D V of u.
sentences.zh: 第三，乘积法则：D(fV)[u] = Df[u]·V + f·DV[u]。

sentences.en: A connection keeps exactly these three properties, and nothing else, as axioms.
sentences.zh: 联络恰好把这三条性质当作公理，别的不要。

sentences.en: An affine connection on M is a map nabla, taking two vector fields X and Y to a vector field nabla X Y.
sentences.zh: M 上的仿射联络是映射 ∇：把两个向量场 X、Y 变成向量场 ∇_X Y。

sentences.en: We read nabla X Y as the derivative of Y in the direction X.
sentences.zh: ∇_X Y 读作 Y 沿方向 X 的导数。

sentences.en: Axiom one: it is C infinity linear in the direction.
sentences.zh: 公理一：对方向 C^∞ 线性。

sentences.en: Nabla along f X plus g Y, of Z, equals f times nabla X Z, plus g times nabla Y Z, for smooth functions f and g.
sentences.zh: ∇_{fX+gY} Z = f∇_X Z + g∇_Y Z，其中 f、g 是光滑函数。

sentences.en: Axiom two: it is R linear in the field being differentiated.
sentences.zh: 公理二：对被求导的场 ℝ 线性。

sentences.en: Nabla X of a Y plus b Z equals a nabla X Y plus b nabla X Z, for real numbers a and b.
sentences.zh: ∇_X(aY + bZ) = a∇_X Y + b∇_X Z，a、b 是实数。

sentences.en: Axiom three: the Leibniz rule. Nabla X of f Y equals f nabla X Y, plus X f times Y.
sentences.zh: 公理三：Leibniz 法则。∇_X(fY) = f∇_X Y + (X f)Y。

sentences.en: Notice the asymmetry. In the direction, functions come out freely. In the field, only constants do.
sentences.zh: 注意不对称：在方向上，函数可以直接提出来；在场上，只有常数可以。

sentences.en: Pulling a function out of the field costs an extra term: X f times Y. That term is what makes nabla a derivative.
sentences.zh: 把函数从场里提出来要多付一项 (X f)Y，正是这一项使 ∇ 成为导数。

sentences.en: Without it, the zero map would satisfy the first two axioms, and the zero map differentiates nothing.
sentences.zh: 没有它，零映射也满足前两条公理，可零映射什么也没求导。

sentences.en: Axiom one has a quieter consequence: nabla X Y at p depends only on the vector X of p.
sentences.zh: 公理一还有一个不那么显眼的推论：(∇_X Y)(p) 只依赖向量 X(p)。

sentences.en: Two direction fields that agree at p, and differ elsewhere, give the same value at p.
sentences.zh: 两个方向场在 p 处相同、别处不同，在 p 处给出相同的值。

sentences.en: That is why we may write nabla v Y, for a single tangent vector v at p.
sentences.zh: 因此可以对 p 处的单个切向量 v 写 ∇_v Y。

sentences.en: Linearity over constants alone would not give this. On R n, D Y of X plus the divergence of X times Y obeys axioms two and three.
sentences.zh: 只对常数线性得不到这一点：ℝⁿ 上 DY[X] + (div X)Y 满足公理二、三。

sentences.en: But replacing X by f X adds X f times Y, and its value at p depends on how X changes near p.
sentences.zh: 但把 X 换成 fX 会多出 (X f)Y，它在 p 的值还依赖 X 在 p 附近的变化。

sentences.en: The ordinary derivative is a connection on R n: nabla X Y equals D Y of X.
sentences.zh: 普通导数是 ℝⁿ 上的联络：∇_X Y = DY[X]。

sentences.en: Check the Leibniz rule: D of f Y along X equals D f of X times Y, plus f D Y of X, which is X f times Y plus f D Y of X.
sentences.zh: 验证 Leibniz：D(fY)[X] = Df[X]·Y + f·DY[X] = (X f)Y + f·DY[X]。

sentences.en: But it is far from the only one.
sentences.zh: 但它远不是唯一的联络。

sentences.en: Add to a connection any B of X and Y that is C infinity linear in both slots. The result is still a connection.
sentences.zh: 给一个联络加上任何对两个位置都 C^∞ 线性的 B(X,Y)，结果仍是联络。

sentences.en: Axioms one and two survive by linearity, and in Leibniz, B of X, f Y is f B of X, Y, which adds no new term.
sentences.zh: 公理一、二由线性保持；Leibniz 中 B(X, fY) = fB(X,Y)，不产生新项。

sentences.en: For example, on R three, D Y of X plus X cross Y is a connection.
sentences.zh: 例如在 ℝ³ 上，DY[X] + X×Y 是联络。

sentences.en: And on the plane, D Y of X plus the inner product of X and Y, times a fixed vector a, is another one.
sentences.zh: 在平面上，DY[X] + ⟨X,Y⟩a（a 是固定向量）是另一个联络。

sentences.en: Same X, same Y, three connections, three different answers.
sentences.zh: 同样的 X 和 Y，三个联络，三个不同的答案。

sentences.en: So the axioms alone do not single out a derivative. The metric will.
sentences.zh: 所以单靠公理挑不出唯一的导数；度量可以。

sentences.en: First, let us see what a connection looks like in coordinates.
sentences.zh: 先看看联络在坐标里是什么样子。

sentences.en: Take local coordinates x one through x n on an open set U of M.
sentences.zh: 在 M 的开集 U 上取局部坐标 x¹,…,xⁿ。

sentences.en: The coordinate vector fields E i, equal to partial over partial x i, form a basis of every tangent space in U.
sentences.zh: 坐标向量场 E_i = ∂/∂xⁱ 在 U 中每个切空间里构成一组基。

sentences.en: So X equals X i E i and Y equals Y j E j, with smooth coefficient functions.
sentences.zh: 于是 X = XⁱE_i，Y = Y^jE_j，系数是光滑函数。

sentences.en: Now expand nabla X Y with the axioms, one step at a time.
sentences.zh: 现在用公理一步步展开 ∇_X Y。

sentences.en: Axiom one pulls the coefficients of the direction out: nabla X Y equals X i times nabla E i of Y j E j.
sentences.zh: 公理一把方向的系数提出来：∇_X Y = Xⁱ∇_{E_i}(Y^jE_j)。

sentences.en: The Leibniz rule splits the rest: X i Y j nabla E i E j, plus X i times partial i of Y j, times E j.
sentences.zh: Leibniz 法则把剩下的拆开：XⁱY^j∇_{E_i}E_j + Xⁱ(∂_iY^j)E_j。

sentences.en: Everything is known except nabla E i E j: the derivative of one coordinate field along another.
sentences.zh: 除了 ∇_{E_i}E_j，其余都已知：一个坐标场沿另一个的导数。

sentences.en: Expand it in the same basis: nabla E i E j equals Gamma k i j times E k.
sentences.zh: 把它也用同一组基展开：∇_{E_i}E_j = Γ^k_ij E_k。

sentences.en: The n cubed functions Gamma k i j are the Christoffel symbols of the connection.
sentences.zh: 这 n³ 个函数 Γ^k_ij 叫做联络的 Christoffel 符号。

sentences.en: So nabla X Y equals X of Y k plus Gamma k i j X i Y j, times E k.
sentences.zh: 所以 ∇_X Y = (X(Y^k) + Γ^k_ij XⁱY^j)E_k。

sentences.en: On U, the connection is completely determined by its Christoffel symbols.
sentences.zh: 在 U 上，联络完全由它的 Christoffel 符号决定。

sentences.en: The first term differentiates the components. The second records how the basis itself changes.
sentences.zh: 第一项对分量求导；第二项记录基本身怎样变化。

sentences.en: Here is a concrete case: the ordinary derivative on the plane, in polar coordinates.
sentences.zh: 看一个具体例子：平面上的普通导数，用极坐标表示。

sentences.en: The coordinate fields are E r, equal to cosine theta, sine theta, and E theta, equal to minus r sine theta, r cosine theta.
sentences.zh: 坐标场是 E_r = (cos θ, sin θ) 和 E_θ = (−r sin θ, r cos θ)。

sentences.en: E r has unit length and points outward. E theta points around, and grows with r.
sentences.zh: E_r 是单位长度、指向外；E_θ 绕圈方向，长度随 r 增大。

sentences.en: Differentiate. Partial r of E r is zero: along a ray, E r does not change.
sentences.zh: 求导。∂_r E_r = 0：沿射线，E_r 不变。

sentences.en: Partial r of E theta is minus sine theta, cosine theta, which is E theta over r.
sentences.zh: ∂_r E_θ = (−sin θ, cos θ) = E_θ / r。

sentences.en: Partial theta of E r is the same vector, E theta over r.
sentences.zh: ∂_θ E_r 是同一个向量 E_θ / r。

sentences.en: And partial theta of E theta is minus r cosine theta, minus r sine theta, which is minus r times E r.
sentences.zh: ∂_θ E_θ = (−r cos θ, −r sin θ) = −r E_r。

sentences.en: So Gamma r theta theta equals minus r, Gamma theta r theta and Gamma theta theta r equal one over r, and the rest vanish.
sentences.zh: 所以 Γ^r_θθ = −r，Γ^θ_rθ = Γ^θ_θr = 1/r，其余为 0。

sentences.en: Look at what Gamma theta theta r says. Walk around a circle: E r turns, and its change points along E theta.
sentences.zh: 看 Γ^θ_θr 的含义：沿圆周走，E_r 在转动，它的变化指向 E_θ 方向。

sentences.en: The field E r has constant components, one and zero. Yet its derivative along E theta is E theta over r, not zero.
sentences.zh: 场 E_r 的分量是常数 (1, 0)，可它沿 E_θ 的导数是 E_θ/r，不是零。

sentences.en: Constant components do not mean a constant field. The Christoffel symbols account for the turning basis.
sentences.zh: 分量是常数不等于场是常量；Christoffel 符号记录的是基的转动。

sentences.en: Could we drop them, and just differentiate components? Try it at r equal to two, theta equal to zero.
sentences.zh: 能不能去掉它们，只对分量求导？在 r = 2、θ = 0 处试一试。

sentences.en: The true derivative of E r along E theta is zero, one. The components-only rule gives zero.
sentences.zh: E_r 沿 E_θ 的真实导数是 (0, 1)，只对分量求导却给出 0。

sentences.en: In Cartesian coordinates, the components-only rule is the ordinary derivative. In polar coordinates it is not.
sentences.zh: 在笛卡尔坐标中，只对分量求导就是普通导数；在极坐标中则不是。

sentences.en: A rule that depends on the chosen coordinates is not a derivative on the manifold. The Gammas cannot be dropped.
sentences.zh: 依赖坐标选择的规则不是流形上的导数；Γ 不能省。

sentences.en: Next, the two properties that tie a connection to the metric.
sentences.zh: 接下来是把联络与度量联系起来的两条性质。

sentences.en: Now let M carry a Riemannian metric. Among all connections, we ask for two more properties.
sentences.zh: 现在让 M 带上黎曼度量。在所有联络中，我们再要求两条性质。

sentences.en: The first is compatibility with the metric.
sentences.zh: 第一条是与度量相容。

sentences.en: X of the inner product of Y and Z equals the inner product of nabla X Y with Z, plus that of Y with nabla X Z.
It is the product rule for inner products, which the ordinary derivative obeys in R n.
sentences.zh: 这是内积的乘积法则，ℝⁿ 中的普通导数满足它。

sentences.en: Its meaning: if two fields have zero derivative along a curve, their lengths and their angle stay constant.
sentences.zh: 它的含义：两个场沿曲线导数为零时，长度和夹角保持不变。

sentences.en: The second property is torsion-freeness: nabla X Y minus nabla Y X equals the Lie bracket of X and Y.
sentences.zh: 第二条是无挠：∇_X Y − ∇_Y X = [X, Y]。

sentences.en: In R n this is the identity we found: D Y of X minus D X of Y is the bracket.
sentences.zh: 在 ℝⁿ 中，这正是我们得到的恒等式：DY[X] − DX[Y] 就是括号。

sentences.en: In coordinates, coordinate fields commute. So torsion-free means nabla E i E j equals nabla E j E i.
sentences.zh: 在坐标中，坐标场对易，所以无挠就是 ∇_{E_i}E_j = ∇_{E_j}E_i。

sentences.en: That is, Gamma k i j equals Gamma k j i for all i and j: the Christoffel symbols are symmetric in the lower indices.
sentences.zh: 也就是对所有 i、j 有 Γ^k_ij = Γ^k_ji：Christoffel 符号对下标对称。

sentences.en: The polar symbols pass this test: Gamma theta r theta and Gamma theta theta r are both one over r.
sentences.zh: 极坐标的符号通过这一检验：Γ^θ_rθ 和 Γ^θ_θr 都是 1/r。

sentences.en: The ordinary derivative on R n has both properties. Do the two properties depend on each other?
sentences.zh: ℝⁿ 上的普通导数两条都满足。这两条性质互相蕴含吗？

sentences.en: They do not. Here is a connection that is compatible but not torsion-free.
sentences.zh: 不互相蕴含。先看一个相容但有挠的联络。

sentences.en: On R three, take nabla X Y equal to D Y of X, plus X cross Y.
sentences.zh: 在 ℝ³ 上取 ∇_X Y = DY[X] + X×Y。

sentences.en: Compatibility: the extra terms are X cross Y dotted with Z, plus Y dotted with X cross Z.
sentences.zh: 相容：多出的项是 ⟨X×Y, Z⟩ + ⟨Y, X×Z⟩。

sentences.en: Those are two determinants with two columns swapped. They cancel, so the connection is compatible.
sentences.zh: 这是交换了两列的两个行列式，相互抵消，所以联络相容。

sentences.en: Torsion: nabla X Y minus nabla Y X minus the bracket equals X cross Y minus Y cross X, which is two X cross Y.
sentences.zh: 挠率：∇_X Y − ∇_Y X − [X,Y] = X×Y − Y×X = 2X×Y。

sentences.en: That is not zero, so the connection has torsion.
sentences.zh: 它不为零，所以联络有挠。

sentences.en: What does it do? Move along the x axis and keep the derivative of a vector zero for this connection.
sentences.zh: 它做了什么？沿 x 轴移动，并让向量在这个联络下导数为零。

sentences.en: The vector obeys z dot equals minus e one cross z. It rotates about the line of motion, like a screw.
sentences.zh: 向量满足 ż = −e₁ × z：绕运动方向旋转，像拧螺丝。

sentences.en: Its length never changes, as compatibility promises. The twisting is the torsion, and the source of the name.
sentences.zh: 长度始终不变，正如相容所保证的；这种拧转就是挠率，名字也由此而来。

sentences.en: Now the opposite case: torsion-free but not compatible.
sentences.zh: 再看相反的情形：无挠但不相容。

sentences.en: On the plane, take nabla X Y equal to D Y of X plus the inner product of X and Y, times a, with a equal to e one.
sentences.zh: 在平面上取 ∇_X Y = DY[X] + ⟨X,Y⟩a，a = e₁。

sentences.en: The extra term is symmetric in X and Y, so it cancels in nabla X Y minus nabla Y X. Torsion-free.
sentences.zh: 多出的项对 X、Y 对称，在 ∇_X Y − ∇_Y X 中抵消，所以无挠。

sentences.en: Compatibility fails. With X, Y and Z all equal to e one, the left side is zero and the right side is two.
sentences.zh: 相容不成立：X、Y、Z 都取 e₁ 时，左边是 0，右边是 2。

sentences.en: Move along the x axis with zero derivative: the first component obeys z one dot equals minus z one, and decays.
sentences.zh: 沿 x 轴保持导数为零：第一分量满足 ż₁ = −z₁，指数衰减。

sentences.en: The vector shrinks and turns, though nothing in the plane is curved. Lengths are no longer kept.
sentences.zh: 平面里什么都没弯曲，向量却在缩短、转向；长度不再保持。

sentences.en: So each property rules out a different defect: compatibility keeps lengths, torsion-freeness forbids twisting.
sentences.zh: 所以两条性质分别排除不同的毛病：相容保长度，无挠禁止拧转。

sentences.en: Next: together, do they pin down a single connection?
sentences.zh: 下一步：两条合在一起，能确定唯一的联络吗？

sentences.en: Here is the answer, the fundamental theorem of Riemannian geometry.
sentences.zh: 答案就是黎曼几何基本定理。

sentences.en: On a Riemannian manifold, there is exactly one connection that is compatible with the metric and torsion-free.
sentences.zh: 黎曼流形上，恰好存在一个与度量相容且无挠的联络。

sentences.en: It is called the Levi-Civita connection, or the Riemannian connection.
sentences.zh: 它叫 Levi-Civita 联络，也叫黎曼联络。

sentences.en: We follow the lecture's proof sketch. Step one derives a formula for it, the Koszul formula.
sentences.zh: 我们按课上的证明概要走。第一步推出它的一个公式：Koszul 公式。

sentences.en: Suppose nabla is compatible and torsion-free. Write compatibility three times, cycling X, Y and Z.
sentences.zh: 设 ∇ 相容且无挠。把相容性写三遍，轮换 X、Y、Z。

sentences.en: First: X of Y, Z equals the inner product of nabla X Y with Z, plus Y with nabla X Z.
sentences.zh: 第一行：X⟨Y,Z⟩ = ⟨∇_X Y, Z⟩ + ⟨Y, ∇_X Z⟩。

sentences.en: Second: Y of Z, X equals nabla Y Z with X, plus Z with nabla Y X.
sentences.zh: 第二行：Y⟨Z,X⟩ = ⟨∇_Y Z, X⟩ + ⟨Z, ∇_Y X⟩。

sentences.en: Third: Z of X, Y equals nabla Z X with Y, plus X with nabla Z Y.
sentences.zh: 第三行：Z⟨X,Y⟩ = ⟨∇_Z X, Y⟩ + ⟨X, ∇_Z Y⟩。

sentences.en: Add the first two lines and subtract the third.
sentences.zh: 前两行相加，减去第三行。

sentences.en: Collect terms by which field sits outside the inner product.
sentences.zh: 按内积外面是哪个场来整理各项。

sentences.en: Y pairs with nabla X Z minus nabla Z X. By torsion-freeness that is the bracket of X and Z.
sentences.zh: 与 Y 配对的是 ∇_X Z − ∇_Z X，由无挠它等于 [X, Z]。

sentences.en: X pairs with nabla Y Z minus nabla Z Y, which is the bracket of Y and Z.
sentences.zh: 与 X 配对的是 ∇_Y Z − ∇_Z Y，等于 [Y, Z]。

sentences.en: Z pairs with nabla X Y plus nabla Y X. Replace nabla Y X by nabla X Y minus the bracket of X and Y.
sentences.zh: 与 Z 配对的是 ∇_X Y + ∇_Y X；把 ∇_Y X 换成 ∇_X Y − [X, Y]。

sentences.en: That leaves twice the inner product of nabla X Y with Z, plus three bracket terms.
sentences.zh: 剩下 2⟨∇_X Y, Z⟩ 加上三个括号项。

sentences.en: Solve for it. Two times nabla X Y, paired with Z, equals X of Y Z, plus Y of Z X, minus Z of X Y,
sentences.zh: 解出它：2⟨∇_X Y, Z⟩ = X⟨Y,Z⟩ + Y⟨Z,X⟩ − Z⟨X,Y⟩

sentences.en: minus X paired with the bracket of Y and Z, plus Y with the bracket of Z and X, plus Z with the bracket of X and Y.
This is the Koszul formula. Look at its right side: there is no nabla in it.
sentences.zh: 这就是 Koszul 公式。看右边：里面没有 ∇。

sentences.en: It involves only the metric, the fields, and their brackets.
sentences.zh: 它只用到度量、场以及它们的括号。

sentences.en: So the inner product of nabla X Y with every Z is fixed in advance.
sentences.zh: 所以 ∇_X Y 与每个 Z 的内积都事先确定了。

sentences.en: By the Riesz theorem, a vector is determined by its inner products with all vectors. So nabla X Y is determined.
sentences.zh: 由 Riesz 定理，一个向量由它与所有向量的内积确定，所以 ∇_X Y 被确定了。

sentences.en: Two compatible, torsion-free connections must therefore agree. That is uniqueness.
sentences.zh: 因此两个相容且无挠的联络必然相同，这就是唯一性。

sentences.en: Step two, existence, runs the formula backwards: define nabla X Y by the Koszul formula.
sentences.zh: 第二步存在性，把公式反过来用：用 Koszul 公式定义 ∇_X Y。

sentences.en: One checks that the right side is C infinity linear in Z, and that the result satisfies all five properties.
sentences.zh: 要验证右边对 Z 是 C^∞ 线性的，并且所得算子满足全部五条性质。

sentences.en: The book calls this direct but tedious. For submanifolds, the next chapter writes the connection down explicitly.
sentences.zh: 书上说这一步直接但繁琐；对子流形，下一章会把联络显式写出来。

sentences.en: The formula is also practical. Put X equal to E i, Y equal to E j, Z equal to E l. All brackets vanish.
sentences.zh: 这个公式也很实用：取 X = E_i、Y = E_j、Z = E_l，所有括号都为零。

sentences.en: With g i j the inner product of E i and E j, we get the classical formula for the Christoffel symbols.
sentences.zh: 记 g_ij = ⟨E_i, E_j⟩，就得到 Christoffel 符号的经典公式。

sentences.en: Gamma k i j equals one half g inverse k l, times partial i g j l plus partial j g i l minus partial l g i j.
sentences.zh: Γ^k_ij = ½ g^{kl}(∂_i g_jl + ∂_j g_il − ∂_l g_ij)。

sentences.en: Check it on polar coordinates, where the metric is diagonal with entries one and r squared.
sentences.zh: 用极坐标检验：度量是对角的，对角元为 1 和 r²。

sentences.en: Gamma r theta theta is one half times minus partial r of r squared, which is minus r.
sentences.zh: Γ^r_θθ = ½·(−∂_r r²) = −r。

sentences.en: Gamma theta r theta is one half times one over r squared, times two r, which is one over r.
Both match what we computed directly from the moving frame. The ordinary derivative on the plane is the Levi-Civita connection.
sentences.zh: 两者都与直接从活动标架算出的结果一致：平面上的普通导数就是 Levi-Civita 联络。

sentences.en: Either property alone left room for other connections. Together, they leave exactly one.
sentences.zh: 单独一条性质都还留有别的联络；两条合起来，只剩唯一一个。

sentences.en: Most manifolds in optimization sit inside a Euclidean space: spheres, the orthogonal group, Stiefel manifolds.
sentences.zh: 优化中的流形大多位于欧氏空间里：球面、正交群、Stiefel 流形。

sentences.en: For them, the Levi-Civita connection has a simple description.
sentences.zh: 对它们，Levi-Civita 联络有一个简单的描述。

sentences.en: Let M sit in R n with the induced metric, and let X be a smooth vector field on M.
sentences.zh: 设 M 位于 ℝⁿ 中、带诱导度量，X 是 M 上的光滑向量场。

sentences.en: Step one: pick a smooth extension X bar of X to an open neighborhood U of M.
sentences.zh: 第一步：取 X 在 M 的开邻域 U 上的光滑延拓 X̅。

sentences.en: Step two: X bar lives on an open set of R n, so its ordinary differential D X bar of p, applied to v, makes sense for every v.
sentences.zh: 第二步：X̅ 定义在 ℝⁿ 的开集上，所以普通微分 DX̅(p)[v] 对每个 v 都有意义。

sentences.en: Step three: project it to the tangent space. Nabla v X equals Proj p of D X bar of p, applied to v.
sentences.zh: 第三步：投影到切空间。∇_v X = Proj_p(DX̅(p)[v])。

sentences.en: Extend, differentiate, project. This is exactly the fix that the circle was asking for.
sentences.zh: 延拓、求导、投影。这正是圆的例子所需要的修正。

sentences.en: First, it does not depend on the extension. Take a curve c on M through p with velocity v.
sentences.zh: 首先，它不依赖延拓。取 M 上过 p、速度为 v 的曲线 c。

sentences.en: D X bar of p, applied to v, is the derivative of X bar along c, which only sees the values of X on M.
sentences.zh: DX̅(p)[v] 是 X̅ 沿 c 的导数，只用到 X 在 M 上的值。

sentences.en: Two extensions, white and purple, differ off the sphere but give the same derivative along it.
sentences.zh: 两个延拓（白色和紫色）在球外不同，沿球面的导数却相同。

sentences.en: Second, it is a connection. D X bar obeys all three axioms, and the projection is linear.
sentences.zh: 其次，它是联络：DX̅ 满足三条公理，投影是线性的。

sentences.en: In the Leibniz rule, the extra term X f times Y is already tangent, so the projection leaves it alone.
sentences.zh: Leibniz 法则中多出的 (X f)Y 本来就是切向的，投影不改变它。

sentences.en: Third, it is compatible with the metric.
sentences.zh: 第三，它与度量相容。

sentences.en: X of Y, Z equals D Y bar of X paired with Z, plus Y paired with D Z bar of X, by the ordinary product rule.
sentences.zh: 由普通乘积法则，X⟨Y,Z⟩ = ⟨DY̅[X], Z⟩ + ⟨Y, DZ̅[X]⟩。

sentences.en: Z is tangent, so pairing with Z ignores the normal part. We may project D Y bar of X for free. Same for the other term.
sentences.zh: Z 是切向量，与 Z 配对时看不到法向部分，可以白白把 DY̅[X] 投影；另一项同理。

sentences.en: Fourth, it is torsion-free. Nabla X Y minus nabla Y X is the projection of D Y bar of X minus D X bar of Y.
sentences.zh: 第四，它无挠。∇_X Y − ∇_Y X 是 DY̅[X] − DX̅[Y] 的投影。

sentences.en: That difference is the bracket of the extensions. We need it to be tangent to M.
sentences.zh: 这个差是两个延拓的李括号，我们需要它切于 M。

sentences.en: Write M as the zero set of h. On M, D h of x applied to Y of x is zero, because Y is tangent.
sentences.zh: 把 M 写成 h 的零点集。在 M 上 Dh(x)[Y(x)] = 0，因为 Y 是切向的。

sentences.en: Differentiate this along the tangent field X: D squared h of X and Y, plus D h of D Y bar of X, equals zero.
sentences.zh: 沿切向场 X 求导：D²h[X, Y] + Dh[DY̅[X]] = 0。

sentences.en: Swap X and Y and subtract. The second derivative D squared h is symmetric, so it cancels.
sentences.zh: 对调 X、Y 再相减。二阶导数 D²h 是对称的，于是抵消。

sentences.en: What remains says D h of the difference is zero: the difference is tangent, and the projection keeps it.
sentences.zh: 剩下的说明 Dh 作用在差上为零：差是切向的，投影保持它不变。

sentences.en: Compatible and torsion-free: by uniqueness, this is the Levi-Civita connection of the submanifold.
sentences.zh: 相容且无挠：由唯一性，这就是子流形的 Levi-Civita 联络。

sentences.en: A caution: with a different, non-induced metric on M, the Levi-Civita connection can be different.
sentences.zh: 提醒一句：如果 M 上用的不是诱导度量，Levi-Civita 联络可能不同。

sentences.en: Now an example on the sphere: the rotation field V of x equals e three cross x.
sentences.zh: 现在看球面上的例子：旋转场 V(x) = e₃ × x。

sentences.en: The same formula extends it to R three, and its differential along u is e three cross u.
sentences.zh: 同一公式就是它在 ℝ³ 上的延拓，沿 u 的微分是 e₃ × u。

sentences.en: So nabla u V is the projection, at x, of e three cross u.
sentences.zh: 所以 ∇_u V = Proj_x(e₃ × u)。

sentences.en: Differentiate V along itself. At a point on the equator, e three cross V of x is minus x: purely normal.
sentences.zh: 让 V 沿自身求导。在赤道上的点，e₃ × V(x) = −x，纯法向。

sentences.en: The projection removes it entirely. Nabla V V is zero on the equator.
sentences.zh: 投影把它完全去掉，赤道上 ∇_V V = 0。

sentences.en: On a latitude circle at polar angle theta, the vector is minus x one, x two, zero. Part of it is tangent.
sentences.zh: 在极角为 θ 的纬线圈上，这个向量是 −(x₁, x₂, 0)，其中一部分是切向的。

sentences.en: The tangent part has length sine theta cosine theta, and points toward the pole.
sentences.zh: 切向部分长度为 sin θ cos θ，指向极点。

sentences.en: Back on the circle: gamma double dot was minus gamma, purely normal. Its projection is zero, as we hoped.
sentences.zh: 回到圆：γ̈ = −γ 纯法向，投影为零，正如我们期望的。

sentences.en: Next, we use this to differentiate the velocity of a curve.
sentences.zh: 下一步，用它对曲线的速度求导。

sentences.en: Along a curve gamma, a vector field Z assigns a tangent vector Z of t at gamma of t.
sentences.zh: 沿曲线 γ 的向量场 Z 在 γ(t) 处给出切向量 Z(t)。

sentences.en: The velocity gamma dot is the most important example.
sentences.zh: 速度 γ̇ 是最重要的例子。

sentences.en: A connection induces a derivative of such fields, D over d t. On a submanifold it is the projected ordinary derivative.
sentences.zh: 联络诱导出这种场的导数 D/dt；在子流形上它就是投影后的普通导数。

sentences.en: D over d t of Z is the projection, at gamma of t, of Z dot of t.
sentences.zh: D/dt Z = Proj_{γ(t)}(Ż(t))。

sentences.en: Apply it to the velocity. The acceleration of gamma is gamma double prime, equal to D over d t of gamma dot.
sentences.zh: 把它用在速度上：γ 的加速度是 γ'' = D/dt γ̇。

sentences.en: On a submanifold, gamma double prime is the tangent part of the ordinary second derivative gamma double dot.
sentences.zh: 在子流形上，γ'' 是普通二阶导数 γ̈ 的切向部分。

sentences.en: A geodesic is a curve with zero acceleration: nabla gamma dot of gamma dot equals zero.
sentences.zh: 测地线是加速度为零的曲线：∇_γ̇ γ̇ = 0。

sentences.en: This is the geodesic equation, boxed on the board. On a submanifold, it says gamma double dot is always normal.
sentences.zh: 这就是板书方框里的测地线方程。在子流形上，它说 γ̈ 始终是法向的。

sentences.en: Test a great circle: gamma of t equals cosine t times x, plus sine t times v, with x and v orthonormal.
sentences.zh: 检验大圆：γ(t) = cos t·x + sin t·v，x 与 v 正交且为单位向量。

sentences.en: Its second derivative is minus gamma: normal to the sphere. So great circles at constant speed are geodesics.
sentences.zh: 它的二阶导数是 −γ，垂直于球面。所以匀速大圆是测地线。

sentences.en: Now a latitude circle at polar angle theta, traversed at unit angular speed.
sentences.zh: 再看极角为 θ 的纬线圈，以单位角速度绕行。

sentences.en: Its second derivative points at the axis, not at the center of the sphere. Part of it is tangent.
sentences.zh: 它的二阶导数指向旋转轴，而不是球心，其中一部分是切向的。

sentences.en: The tangent part has length sine theta cosine theta, the same number as before, and points toward the pole.
sentences.zh: 切向部分长度为 sin θ cos θ，与上一章的数相同，指向极点。

sentences.en: At sixty degrees it is 0.433, at forty-five degrees 0.5, at thirty degrees 0.433 again.
Only at the equator, ninety degrees, does it vanish. The equator is a great circle; the other latitudes are not geodesics.
sentences.zh: 只有在 90° 的赤道它才为零。赤道是大圆，其他纬线都不是测地线。

sentences.en: A walker on a latitude must keep turning toward the pole to stay on it.
sentences.zh: 沿纬线走的人必须不断朝极点方向转弯，才能留在纬线上。

sentences.en: Constant speed is not the criterion either. Every latitude here is traversed at constant speed.
sentences.zh: 速率恒定也不是判据：这里每条纬线都是匀速走的。

sentences.en: But geodesics do have constant speed: the derivative of gamma dot squared is two gamma double prime paired with gamma dot, which is zero.
sentences.zh: 但测地线确实匀速：|γ̇|² 的导数是 2⟨γ'', γ̇⟩ = 0。

sentences.en: That step used compatibility with the metric.
sentences.zh: 这一步用到了与度量相容。

sentences.en: In coordinates, write gamma dot as x dot j times E j and differentiate with the connection.
sentences.zh: 在坐标中，把 γ̇ 写成 ẋ^jE_j，再用联络求导。

sentences.en: Gamma double prime equals x double dot k, plus Gamma k i j x dot i x dot j, times E k.
sentences.zh: γ'' = (ẍ^k + Γ^k_ij ẋⁱẋ^j)E_k。

sentences.en: So the geodesic equation becomes x double dot k plus Gamma k i j x dot i x dot j equals zero, for every k.
sentences.zh: 于是测地线方程变成：对每个 k，ẍ^k + Γ^k_ij ẋⁱẋ^j = 0。

sentences.en: In polar coordinates: r double dot minus r theta dot squared equals zero, and theta double dot plus two over r, r dot theta dot, equals zero.
sentences.zh: 极坐标中：r̈ − rθ̇² = 0，θ̈ + (2/r)ṙθ̇ = 0。

sentences.en: Plug in the straight line x equals one, at unit speed. Both residuals come out below three times ten to the minus sixteen.
sentences.zh: 代入单位速率的直线 x = 1，两个残差都小于 3×10⁻¹⁶。

sentences.en: Straight lines are the geodesics of the plane, even when written in curved coordinates.
sentences.zh: 直线是平面的测地线，即使用弯曲的坐标来写也是如此。

sentences.en: The geodesic equation is a smooth second-order ODE. Given a starting point x and a velocity v, it has a unique solution for a while.
sentences.zh: 测地线方程是光滑的二阶常微分方程；给定起点 x 和速度 v，它在一段时间内有唯一解。

sentences.en: That is the existence and uniqueness theorem for ODEs, which rests on the contraction mapping principle.
sentences.zh: 这就是 ODE 的存在唯一性定理，它建立在压缩映射原理之上。

sentences.en: So a geodesic is determined by its initial point and initial velocity: one geodesic for each tangent vector.
sentences.zh: 所以测地线由初始点和初始速度决定：每个切向量对应一条测地线。

sentences.en: On the sphere, shooting from one point in every direction gives a fan of great circles.
sentences.zh: 在球面上，从一点向各个方向射出，得到一扇大圆。

sentences.en: Next, we package this fan into a single map.
sentences.zh: 下一步，把这扇测地线打包成一个映射。

sentences.en: Fix a point x. For a tangent vector v, let gamma v be the geodesic with gamma v of zero equal to x and initial velocity v.
sentences.zh: 固定点 x。对切向量 v，令 γ_v 为 γ_v(0) = x、初速度为 v 的测地线。

sentences.en: The exponential map sends v to the point gamma v of one. Exp x of v equals gamma v of one.
sentences.zh: 指数映射把 v 送到点 γ_v(1)：Exp_x(v) = γ_v(1)。

sentences.en: It is defined on the open set of v for which the geodesic lasts until time one.
sentences.zh: 它定义在使测地线能延续到 t = 1 的那些 v 构成的开集上。

sentences.en: Rescaling the velocity rescales time: gamma of t v at time s equals gamma v at time t s.
sentences.zh: 速度放大，时间就相应缩短：γ_{tv}(s) = γ_v(ts)。

sentences.en: So Exp x of t v equals gamma v of t. Moving along the ray t v in the tangent space traces the geodesic.
sentences.zh: 所以 Exp_x(tv) = γ_v(t)：在切空间中沿射线 tv 移动，就描出这条测地线。

sentences.en: On the sphere, geodesics are great circles, and we can write the map down.
sentences.zh: 在球面上，测地线是大圆，可以把映射写出来。

sentences.en: Exp x of v equals cosine of the norm of v, times x, plus sine of the norm of v, times v over its norm.
sentences.zh: Exp_x(v) = cos‖v‖·x + sin‖v‖·v/‖v‖。

sentences.en: Walk a distance equal to the length of v along the great circle in direction v.
sentences.zh: 沿方向 v 的大圆走过等于 ‖v‖ 的距离。

sentences.en: On the sphere it is defined on the whole tangent plane.
sentences.zh: 在球面上，它定义在整个切平面上。

sentences.en: Circles of radius rho in the tangent plane go to latitude circles at distance rho from x.
sentences.zh: 切平面上半径为 ρ 的圆，被送到与 x 相距 ρ 的纬线圈。

sentences.en: As rho grows to pi, these circles shrink again, and the whole circle of radius pi lands on the antipode, minus x.
sentences.zh: ρ 增大到 π 时，这些圆又缩小，半径 π 的整个圆都落到对径点 −x。

sentences.en: So Exp x is one-to-one only for vectors shorter than pi. Pi is the injectivity radius of the sphere.
sentences.zh: 所以 Exp_x 只在长度小于 π 的向量上是单射；π 是球面的单射半径。

sentences.en: The exponential map is a retraction. Exp x of zero is x, because the geodesic starts there.
sentences.zh: 指数映射是 retraction。Exp_x(0) = x，因为测地线从这里出发。

sentences.en: And the derivative of Exp x of t v at t equal to zero is gamma v dot of zero, which is v. So its differential at zero is the identity.
sentences.zh: Exp_x(tv) 在 t = 0 处的导数是 γ̇_v(0) = v，所以它在 0 处的微分是恒等映射。

sentences.en: It does more than a retraction must. The curve t maps to Exp x of t v has zero acceleration, not only at the start but everywhere.
sentences.zh: 它比 retraction 要求的更多：曲线 t ↦ Exp_x(tv) 的加速度处处为零，不只是在起点。

sentences.en: A retraction R is called second order if the curve c of t equals R x of t v has c double prime of zero equal to zero.
sentences.zh: 若曲线 c(t) = R_x(tv) 满足 c''(0) = 0，retraction R 称为二阶的。

sentences.en: The exponential map is second order. What about the normalization retraction from episode six?
sentences.zh: 指数映射是二阶的。第六集的归一化 retraction 呢？

sentences.en: Its curve is x plus t v, divided by the square root of one plus t squared.
sentences.zh: 它的曲线是 (x + tv)/√(1 + t²)。

sentences.en: At t equal to zero, its ordinary second derivative is minus x: purely normal. So c double prime of zero is zero. Second order too.
sentences.zh: 在 t = 0 处，它的普通二阶导数是 −x，纯法向，所以 c''(0) = 0，也是二阶的。

sentences.en: Measure it. The distance between R x of t v and Exp x of t v, divided by t cubed, is 0.305, 0.326, 0.331 and 0.333.
sentences.zh: 实测：R_x(tv) 与 Exp_x(tv) 的距离除以 t³，依次是 0.305、0.326、0.331、0.333。

sentences.en: It tends to one third. The two curves agree to second order; they separate only at third order.
sentences.zh: 它趋于 1/3：两条曲线二阶一致，只在三阶上分开。

sentences.en: Now a retraction that is only first order. Push x plus v a little sideways: add one half the norm of v squared times w, then normalize.
sentences.zh: 再看一个只是一阶的 retraction：把 x + v 稍微侧推，加上 ½‖v‖²w，再归一化。

sentences.en: Here w is a fixed unit tangent vector orthogonal to v. Both retraction conditions still hold.
sentences.zh: 这里 w 是与 v 正交的固定单位切向量；retraction 的两个条件仍然成立。

sentences.en: But its curve accelerates sideways: c double prime of zero equals w, not zero.
sentences.zh: 但它的曲线侧向加速：c''(0) = w，不为零。

sentences.en: Its distance to Exp, divided by t squared, is 0.479, 0.495, 0.499: it tends to one half.
sentences.zh: 它与 Exp 的距离除以 t²，依次是 0.479、0.495、0.499，趋于 1/2。

sentences.en: On a log-log plot, the normalization error has slope three, the sideways one slope two.
sentences.zh: 在对数坐标图上，归一化的误差斜率为 3，侧推的斜率为 2。

sentences.en: First-order analysis, like the convergence of gradient descent, works with any retraction.
sentences.zh: 一阶分析（例如梯度下降的收敛性）用任何 retraction 都行。

sentences.en: Second-order analysis, like computing Hessians through pullbacks, needs a second-order retraction, or a critical point.
sentences.zh: 二阶分析（例如用拉回计算 Hessian）需要二阶 retraction，或者在临界点处。

sentences.en: Next: how to carry a tangent vector from one point to another.
sentences.zh: 下一步：怎样把一个切向量从一点搬到另一点。

sentences.en: We still cannot compare tangent vectors at different points. Parallel transport fixes that, one curve at a time.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然无法比较不同点的切向量。平行移动沿着一条条曲线解决这个问题。

sentences.en: A vector field Z along a curve gamma is called parallel if its covariant derivative vanishes: D over d t of Z equals zero.
sentences.zh: 沿曲线 γ 的向量场 Z 若协变导数为零，即 D/dt Z = 0，就称为平行的。

sentences.en: In coordinates this is a linear ODE for the components of Z, so each initial vector gives exactly one parallel field.
sentences.zh: 在坐标中，这是 Z 的分量满足的线性 ODE，所以每个初始向量恰好给出一个平行场。

sentences.en: Parallel transport along gamma maps the initial vector Z of zero to the final vector Z of one.
sentences.zh: 沿 γ 的平行移动把初始向量 Z(0) 送到终点向量 Z(1)。

sentences.en: It goes from the tangent space at gamma of zero to the tangent space at gamma of one.
sentences.zh: 它是从 γ(0) 处的切空间到 γ(1) 处的切空间的映射。

sentences.en: It is linear, because the equation is linear.
sentences.zh: 它是线性的，因为方程是线性的。

sentences.en: And it is an isometry. For two parallel fields Z and W, the derivative of their inner product is zero.
sentences.zh: 它还是等距：对两个平行场 Z 和 W，它们内积的导数为零。

sentences.en: By compatibility, that derivative is D Z over d t paired with W, plus Z paired with D W over d t. Both are zero.
sentences.zh: 由相容性，这个导数等于 ⟨D/dt Z, W⟩ + ⟨Z, D/dt W⟩，两项都是零。

sentences.en: Lengths and angles are preserved. With the shrinking connection from chapter five, they would not be.
sentences.zh: 长度与夹角都保持；若用第五章那个会缩短向量的联络，就不会如此。

sentences.en: On the sphere, D over d t of Z equals zero means Z dot is normal, a multiple of gamma.
sentences.zh: 在球面上，D/dt Z = 0 意味着 Ż 是法向的，是 γ 的倍数。

sentences.en: Since Z stays orthogonal to gamma, the multiple is fixed: Z dot equals minus the inner product of Z and gamma dot, times gamma.
sentences.zh: 由于 Z 始终与 γ 正交，这个倍数是确定的：Ż = −⟨Z, γ̇⟩γ。

sentences.en: Along a great circle, the velocity is itself parallel, because the curve is a geodesic.
sentences.zh: 沿大圆，速度本身就是平行的，因为这条曲线是测地线。

sentences.en: So a parallel vector keeps a constant angle with the direction of travel.
sentences.zh: 所以平行向量与前进方向保持恒定夹角。

sentences.en: Naive translation would not work: a constant vector of R three leaves the tangent plane as we move.
sentences.zh: 简单平移行不通：ℝ³ 中的常向量随着移动会离开切平面。

sentences.en: Now carry a vector around a triangle made of three great-circle arcs, one eighth of the sphere.
sentences.zh: 现在把一个向量沿由三段大圆弧组成的三角形搬一圈，它是球面的八分之一。

sentences.en: Start at the north pole with the vector pointing toward e one, and walk down the meridian to e one.
sentences.zh: 从北极出发，向量指向 e₁，沿经线走到 e₁。

sentences.en: The vector points along the path, so it stays the velocity. At e one it points straight down: minus e three.
sentences.zh: 向量沿路径方向，所以一直是速度方向；到 e₁ 时它指向正下方 −e₃。

sentences.en: Walk along the equator to e two. Now the vector is perpendicular to the path, and stays minus e three.
sentences.zh: 沿赤道走到 e₂。此时向量垂直于路径，保持为 −e₃。

sentences.en: Climb the meridian back to the pole. The vector points backward along this path, and arrives as e two.
sentences.zh: 沿经线爬回北极。向量沿这段路径指向后方，到达时变成 e₂。

sentences.en: It started as e one and came back as e two: rotated by ninety degrees, with length still one.
sentences.zh: 出发时是 e₁，回来时是 e₂：转了 90°，长度仍为 1。

sentences.en: A numerical integration of the parallel transport equation agrees to twelve digits.
sentences.zh: 对平行移动方程做数值积分，结果在十二位数字上吻合。

sentences.en: Ninety degrees is pi over two, which is exactly the area of the triangle. That is the curvature of the sphere showing up.
sentences.zh: 90° 就是 π/2，恰好等于三角形的面积，这是球面曲率在起作用。

sentences.en: So parallel transport depends on the path. On a curved manifold there is no global way to compare vectors.
sentences.zh: 所以平行移动依赖路径；在弯曲的流形上，没有比较向量的整体方式。

sentences.en: Along a chosen curve, though, it is exactly what optimizers need.
sentences.zh: 不过沿一条选定的曲线，它正是优化算法需要的。

sentences.en: Conjugate gradients and BFGS combine the new gradient with old ones, which live at old iterates.
sentences.zh: 共轭梯度和 BFGS 要把新梯度与旧梯度结合，而旧梯度位于旧的迭代点。

sentences.en: They must first be carried to the new point. Parallel transport, or a cheaper transporter, does that.
sentences.zh: 必须先把它们搬到新点；平行移动，或者更便宜的 transporter，负责这件事。

sentences.en: Let us collect what we built.
sentences.zh: 整理一下我们搭起来的东西。

sentences.en: The naive derivative of a velocity field leaves the tangent space: the circle showed it.
sentences.zh: 速度场的显然导数会离开切空间：圆的例子说明了这一点。

sentences.en: Vector fields act on functions, and their Lie bracket is again a vector field.
sentences.zh: 向量场作用在函数上，它们的李括号仍是向量场。

sentences.en: A connection keeps the three properties of a derivative. In coordinates it is described by Christoffel symbols.
sentences.zh: 联络保留导数的三条性质；在坐标中由 Christoffel 符号描述。

sentences.en: Compatibility keeps lengths; torsion-freeness forbids twisting. Each fails without the other.
sentences.zh: 相容保长度，无挠禁止拧转，缺一不可。

sentences.en: Together they determine one connection, by the Koszul formula: the Levi-Civita connection.
sentences.zh: 两者合起来经由 Koszul 公式确定唯一的联络：Levi-Civita 联络。

sentences.en: On a submanifold, it is the ordinary derivative followed by the orthogonal projection.
sentences.zh: 在子流形上，它就是普通导数再做正交投影。

sentences.en: Geodesics have zero acceleration. The exponential map follows them, and is a second-order retraction.
sentences.zh: 测地线加速度为零；指数映射沿测地线走，是二阶 retraction。

sentences.en: Parallel transport carries vectors along curves as isometries, and depends on the path.
sentences.zh: 平行移动沿曲线以等距方式搬运向量，并且依赖路径。

sentences.en: The connection also gives the missing Hessian. Hess f of x, applied to u, equals nabla u of grad f.
sentences.zh: 联络还给出了缺失的 Hessian：Hess f(x)[u] = ∇_u grad f。

sentences.en: For the Rayleigh quotient on the sphere, this is Proj x of A u, minus x transpose A x times u.
sentences.zh: 对球面上的瑞利商，它是 Proj_x(Au) − (xᵀAx)u。

sentences.en: The troublesome normal term from chapter one is gone.
sentences.zh: 第一章里那个麻烦的法向项不见了。

sentences.en: At e three its eigenvalues are one and three, the numbers we met for local convergence in episode seven.
sentences.zh: 在 e₃ 处它的特征值是 1 和 3，正是第七集局部收敛中见过的数。

sentences.en: Next time: the Riemannian Hessian in earnest, and Newton's method on manifolds.
sentences.zh: 下一集：认真讨论黎曼 Hessian，以及流形上的 Newton 方法。
